clips.descripcion:
In GTA 6 a quiet bank robbery gives you no stars while you loot. The wanted level only pops once the cash is gone, and the cops are still on the way.

Gameplay: Fear (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you go back for more cash or run the second the stars hit? 💰
clips.motivo: Police alert timing during a heist, clear HUD payoff when stars appear

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 a *bank* robbery starts with zero cops?
Hostages stay *on the floor* while you loot the counters.
The *cash counter* climbs, and still no stars.
Then you grab the *last* stack and...
*Boom*, stars hit the top right.
But the cops aren't there yet, so you *walk out*.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #10: Cops Come AFTER You Grab The CASH 💰

clips.descripcion:
In GTA 6 you have to keep the whole bank scared, guards included. Keep aiming and they drop their weapons, let up and they fight back.

Gameplay: Fear (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Intimidate everyone or take the guards out first? 🔫
clips.motivo: Intimidation mechanic vs armed guards, visible dropped weapon

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 you have to *threaten* the whole bank?
Aim at everyone, even the *security guards*, so nobody calls backup.
Keep them scared and they *drop* to the floor.
Even the armed guards *drop their weapons*.
Stop intimidating and they'll eventually *shoot* back.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #11: Even ARMED GUARDS Drop Their Guns 🔫

clips.descripcion:
With stars on you in GTA 6, the map shows a flashing red and blue police search zone. Pay 'n' Spray shops inside it are no help, so pick one outside.

Gameplay: Fear (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you risk the closest Pay 'n' Spray or drive across town? 🚨
clips.motivo: Police search area on map + Pay 'n' Spray lowering recognition

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 the map shows a police *search zone*?
Your minimap *flashes red and blue* while they hunt you.
Every *Pay 'n' Spray* inside that zone is off limits.
So you mark one *outside* the zone instead.
A respray *lowers recognition*, so cops won't know your car.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #12: Cops Draw A SEARCH ZONE 🚨

Gameplay: Fear (YouTube)

clips.comentario: Which bank are you hitting first? 💸
clips.motivo: On-screen bank intel (marked bills, dye pack jammer) plus safe cash payoff

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 banks are loaded with *marked bills*?
You need a *dye pack jammer* before they're worth hitting.
Then punch the *code* into the safe.
Inside? *Stacks* of cash for the bag.
Then clean out the *teller* counters too.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #13: Banks Have MARKED BILLS 💸
